sketch:
Observe: SVG bench with two lenses — objectif f'₁ and oculaire f'₂
spaced by f'₁ + f'₂ (afocal setup). Parallel rays from a distant
star focus at intermediate F'₁ = F₂, then re-emerge parallel to the
eye. Student drags spacing; when afocal, HUD shows G = f'₁/f'₂.
Experiment: 3 seeded magnification targets; student picks f'₁, f'₂
pairs to match. Evaluate: intermediate rays hidden; only object
angle α and image angle α' shown as HUD numbers; student sets lenses
so α'/α equals target G blind. Wrinkle: afocal-condition check
separate from G.
